_comment: Claude Code themes pfm install places into ~/.claude/themes/ (a user-level dir, shared by every project and, when their themes/ dirs are symlinked, by the fleet accounts). Two kinds. source_fetched: fetched at install from the theme's canonical public repo, always latest — the blueprint never vendors a copy. bundled: a `file` beside this manifest, read from the source clone or downloaded from beside the release manifest; with `base` it is an overlay — only `name` and the differing `overrides` — written merged onto the fetched base. Both kinds are recorded in the install ownership ledger. Activate with /theme, or set `theme` in an account's settings.json.

professor-gold.activate: /theme → "Professor Gold" — Tokyo Night with the 🥇 account 1 input bar (#ffd60a); per account: "theme": "custom:professor-gold" in that account's settings.json

professor-silver.activate: /theme → "Professor Silver" — Tokyo Night with the 🥈 account 2 input bar (#c8d9ff); per account: "theme": "custom:professor-silver" in that account's settings.json

professor-bronze.activate: /theme → "Professor Bronze" — Tokyo Night with the 🥉 account 3 input bar (#ff7a1a); per account: "theme": "custom:professor-bronze" in that account's settings.json
